parts.name: Part A: Life Cycle Assessment Calculation Rules and Report Requirements
Part B: Water-Cooled Chiller EPD Requirements

product.name: EX-650 Water-Cooled Centrifugal Chiller
product.variantsText: The product range covers 350 to 1,150 tons; the 650-ton configuration is assessed.
product.description: The EX-650 is a water-cooled centrifugal chiller with a two-stage compressor and oil-free bearings, using the low-GWP refrigerant R-1233zd(E).
product.intendedApplication: Providing chilled water for cooling the interior of commercial buildings.
product.hazardousSubstancesStatement: No substances required to be reported as hazardous are associated with the production of this product.

functionalUnit.referenceProductDescription: 650-ton water-cooled centrifugal chiller incl. refrigerant charge

manufacturing.processDescription: Shells and tubes are fabricated, brazed and assembled with the compressor, motor and controls; units are pressure tested and charged with refrigerant.

B1.description: Direct refrigerant emissions during use are reported in B1.

B2.description: A 2% annual refrigerant leakage and replacement rate is assumed.

B3.description: Repairs are limited to minor component replacement.

B4.description: The chiller is replaced at the end of its reference service life.

B5.description: No refurbishment is expected within the reference service life.

B6.calculationMethodText: Operational energy is calculated from the IPLV and the PCR default load profile over the 75-year building service life.

supplementalResults.title: B6 operational energy with alternative electricity grids
supplementalResults.description: B6 results per ton of chilling capacity using alternative grid mixes.

references.citation: Example Climate Systems Inc. (2026). LCA background report for the EX-650 chiller (confidential).

customSections.title: Additional environmental information
customSections.markdown:
The EX-650 uses **R-1233zd(E)**, a refrigerant with a 100-year GWP of 1.

- Oil-free bearings remove the need for oil replacement
- Variable-speed drive improves part-load efficiency
